posts.description: Minimal and usable dark mode toggles From Dark mode toggles, two states are enough : Yes, the underlying model must have three states, but one is always irrelevant to the actual user goal. Users do not seek out solutions to problems they don’t currently have. A lot of the hate towards two-state toggles is based on poor implementations.
